status: Declared before new demand audit and refits; November-December outcomes were inspected in the preceding research pass and are not a fresh confirmatory holdout.
purpose: Diagnose predicted sales composition and evaluate candidate demand models without loading cost bounds or choosing performance tolerances.
audit: Calibration by device model-storage-condition, displayed-price bin, listing age, calendar month, and new/continuing listings
Compare prediction errors within and across categories
Audit missing outcomes, date gaps, price changes near terminal sales, and available feedback fields
calendar: Day of week categories plus linear elapsed calendar time; no unknown future week indicators in new cell models.
selection: Report every declared model in every split; log loss and calibration are primary predictive criteria. Do not select by cost bounds. Any later extension must be labeled exploratory.
causal_checks: Compare counts and outcomes around large common price cuts, including pre-change sales rates
Record feedback/initialization/adoption evidence separately from pricing fit
Do not infer price exogeneity from predictive improvement or from a failed placebo test
regret_routes: Known-algorithm finite-sample guarantees with feedback, normalization, initialization and adoption checks
Variation-based or short-window guarantees only with a complete proof and separately supported assumptions
Direct empirical policy evaluation: distinguish estimation of candidate-cost regret from an independently justified behavioral ceiling
prohibition: Do not label cost intervals credible unless both the structural demand uncertainty and the observed-window performance event are supported; preserve negative results.
